messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning a dedicated GPU pool swap for tonight 23:00 UTC. Goal: move model-prod-1 traffic from pool-orbit-a -> pool-orbit-b (new autoscale policy). Who can own deploy and smoke?

maria: I can own the policy change. PR is open (#4028). It updates min_replicas from 2 -> 3 and adds a 5m burst window. lmk if you want different numbers.

simon: I can run the deploy and do the smoke checks. Will be available from 22:45 UTC. tagging @jess for on-call smoke validation.

jess: SGTM, I'll do the smoke validation post-deploy. Quick question: what are the exact smoke criteria? CPU/GPU util thresholds? latency SLOs?

alex: Good q. Minimal smoke checklist: - model infer latency p95 < 300ms for 1k sample test - no 5xx errors for 10m - KV cache warmup within 2 tokens median. If any fail, roll back.

simon: Copying checklist to runbook and will run the following command in staging-runner before prod:```bash
tools/deploy_swap --from pool-orbit-a --to pool-orbit-b --dry-run
```

jess: For smoke harness, I'll run the perf script:```python
# perf check
load_test(samples=1000, model_endpoint='model-prod-1', concurrency=8)
assert p95 < 0.3
```

maria: Autoscale params being applied are:```yaml
pool: pool-orbit-b
min_replicas: 3
max_replicas: 40
burst_window: 5m
scale_up_policy: threshold( gpu_util>70, window=30s )
```

ops-lead: Two quick ops items: 1) Keep the old pool registered for 10 minutes post-cutover for quick rollback. 2) If rollout fails, we revert traffic back to pool-orbit-a and revert autoscale config in infra-ctl. Who has perms to do that revert?

simon: I do. I've got infra-ctl access and will be ready to flip traffic. Jess will confirm smoke fail.

jess: I'll post results in this thread within 5m of completion. If I react :thumbsup:, consider it good. If I post errors, start rollback immediately.

alex: Estimating ~10m for the swap including warmup. Target timeline: 22:50 UTC - pre-checks, 23:00 UTC - swap, 23:05-23:15 - smoke. If all good, promote and close.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by simon for 2822468400 (23:00 UTC). Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redeploy/pool-swap (access: eng,ops).

maria: PR #4028 link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4028 - reviewers: @alex, @ops-lead. Please review ASAP so policy can be applied prior to swap.

ops-lead: I'll be online during the window. One more ask: simulate a small burst during smoke to verify burst_window behaves as expected.

simon: Will inject a 20req/s spike for 2m during smoke.

jess: Noted. If everything passes I'll update the deployment ticket and mark the rollout success. Otherwise I'll paste logs and mark rollback started.

alex: Thanks all. Ping here if anything blocks. @simon @jess please confirm once pre-checks done. :v:
